isolation: Two actual atlas modules and their matching unit-appearance providers compiled from frozen source bytes with separate module namespaces. Before atlas and appearance artifacts both match the pinned Git commit byte for byte. Each atlas owns its real RasterCache; each appearance provider owns its own catalog objects, memo map and candidate WeakSet brand. Fixture appearanceFor calls use the matching provider, never a third appearance module. Portrait-fit is duplicated with identical source bytes and independent FittedPortraitCache instances. Other unchanged body and scratch-canvas dependencies are frozen from the same current source graph.
scope: Exact CPU Canvas correctness and actual cache reuse only. Complete original RGBA (including transparent RGB), crop, final entry output and untimed cache/source-read counts. No rendering-time or game-memory claim; no WebGL context, renderer, simulation, benchmark or per-frame observer.
method: Actual isolated before/candidate atlas and matching appearanceFor providers. Real readonly unit/items/owner facts are checked with unchanged canEquip/itemHands/wieldRefusal rules; each provider constructs its own objects. New nonempty catalog aliases are compared against two independently painted old raw sources. d07 plain-empty regressions already cache-hit in both providers. Full original source RGBA, including world shadows and transparent RGB, exact crop/final drawImage arguments and entire output RGBA are hashed without tolerance. No standalone painter substitutes, simulation commands or timing.
limitations: Finite declared matrix; complete new stock-issued idle density/facing matrix, bounded older-empty regressions and representative changed gear. No claim for all custom inputs or campaign variants.
Readonly snapshot kit preflight is not simulation equip-command coverage; focused production tests own that scope.
Portrait/figure APIs take no animation pose: their actual IDLE route, provider-owned gear/cloth values and cache ownership are checked; no new UI cross-pose benefit is claimed.
FittedPortraitCache has no public miss counter; observed full-domain reads are cross-checked with entry deltas.
Observers add readbacks, hashing and yields; this is correctness/cache reuse evidence, not performance or process-memory measurement.
No WebGL, simulation, event, release socket or picking proof.
Each provider cache is cleared per group. Only hashes/counts/metadata survive; source/crop/output bytes and fixture output canvases are released per step.
